sourceType.description: The type for which the API is being generated, if created through #forType.

title:
Each type declares a set of APIs (functions) and/or data fields. These declarations can be consumed by external
systems to expose types to their consumers in other API declaration forms.

Where the API declaration languages are lower-fidelity than C3 types, broader declarations are generated. Thus some
values allowed by the produced declarations may not actually be valid when executed against the type. For example,
C3 has many different kinds of numbers, but JavaScript has only "number". So if a method is declared with an `int`
parameter, it can only be represented as `number`.
name: ApiGenerator
